data.name: MNH2_001
data.value: I finally have some time to myself.[pause=0] I think I'll catch up on some reading.

data.name: MNH2_002
data.value: Hey![pause=0] What are you two doing over there?

data.name: MNH2_003
data.value: {0} is down for his nap.[pause=0] Please don't wake him up!

data.name: MNH2_004
data.value: O-oh.[pause=0] Sorry ma'am!

data.name: MNH2_005
data.value: I won't be able to sleep peacefully until I know he's back home with his mom,[pause=10] safe and sound.

data.name: MNH2_006
data.value: I haven't seen him in a while though.[pause=0] Maybe if I wasn't snoozing so much in town,[pause=10] I'd have spotted him...

data.name: MNH4_001
data.value: This is seriously going to cut into my snoozing time...

data.name: MNH5_001
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] {0},[pause=10] look!

data.name: MNH5_002
data.value: ...[pause=30]You're leaving on the expedition today?

data.name: MNH5_003
data.value: Yup.[pause=0] The Guildmaster announced we'd be departing later today.

data.name: MNH5_004
data.value: It's kinda sudden though,[pause=10] isn't it?[pause=0] You said the guild was going on an expedition,[pause=10] but we thought there'd be more warning!

data.name: MNH5_005
data.value: Yeah.[pause=0] The Guildmaster wants us to leave now that {0} and {1} are back.

data.name: MNH5_006
data.value: I thought he'd give them a day or two to rest,[pause=10] but it seems he's eager to get going.

data.name: MNH5_007
data.value: It's unfortunate you have to leave on such little notice,[pause=10] but...[pause=30] we understand.[pause=0] I'm sure your Guildmaster knows best.

data.name: MNH5_008
data.value: Sounds more to me like he's just as excited as you are for this expedition,[pause=10] hehe!

data.name: MNH5_009
data.value: Hehe,[pause=10] maybe.[pause=0] It is all very exciting, after all!

data.name: MNH5_010
data.value: But...[pause=0] I'm feeling nervous too.[pause=0] This is my first expedition...[pause=30] it's daunting.

data.name: MNH5_011
data.value: I've studied and trained and prepared...[pause=0] But I'm still worried I might not pull my own weight.

data.name: MNH5_012
data.value: I don't want to let {0},[pause=10] the Guildmaster,[pause=10] or anyone else down!

data.name: MNH5_013
data.value: No way![pause=0] You're an adventurer,[pause=10] and adventures are awesome!

data.name: MNH5_014
data.value: You're gonna do great, {0}![pause=0] And you'll find something really cool,[pause=10] or lots of treasure!

data.name: MNH5_016
data.value: Your brother's right,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: MNH5_017
data.value: I'm worried about all the trouble and dangers you'll face on your expedition...

data.name: MNH5_018
data.value: But you're a smart and capable Pokémon.[pause=0] I know you'll do great.

data.name: MNH5_019
data.value: Just stay safe,[pause=10] okay?[pause=0] We don't want to see you get hurt.[pause=0] Keep your wits about you!

data.name: MNH5_020
data.value: And don't push yourself too hard.[pause=0] Make sure you get plenty of rest!

data.name: MNH5_021
data.value: I know this expedition is very important and lots of work,[pause=10] but you have to take care of yourself too,[pause=10] you know?

data.name: MNH5_022
data.value: Mom...[pause=0] Dad...

data.name: MNH5_023
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] You're right![pause=0] I can do this!

data.name: MNH5_024
data.value: I'm gonna try my absolute hardest![pause=0] I'll learn and do everything I can!

data.name: MNH5_025
data.value: I'll make you and everyone else proud of me!

data.name: MNH5_026
data.value: I know you will.[pause=0] And when you come back home...

data.name: MNH5_027
data.value: ...[pause=30]Be sure to share with me all your writings.[pause=0] I'd love to read about your adventure!

data.name: MNH5_028
data.value: I'd love it if you brought home a really cool treasure![pause=0] Something shiny and awesome!

data.name: MNH5_029
data.value: Hey, you know what I'd love?

data.name: MNH5_030
data.value: ...A great big hug!

data.name: MNH5_031
data.value: Dad...

data.name: MNH5_032
data.value: You know, I think I'd love one of those as well.

data.name: MNH5_033
data.value: Hey![pause=0] I want a hug too!

data.name: MNH5_035
data.value: ...Well,[pause=10] I'd better get going.[pause=0] I still need to prepare with {0} for the long journey ahead.

data.name: MNH5_036
data.value: Goodbye everyone.[pause=0] I'll...

data.name: MNH5_037
data.value: I'll do my best!

data.name: MNH5_038
data.value: Bye,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] Hope you find lots of cool stuff!

data.name: MNH5_039
data.value: Good luck![pause=0] Make sure you take plenty of breaks!

data.name: MNH5_040
data.value: {0}.[pause=0] I know you'll do wonderfully on this expedition.

data.name: MNH5_041
data.value: But as your mother, I can't help but worry.[pause=0] So,[pause=10] please,[pause=10] just ensure you come back home safe.

data.name: MNH5_042
data.value: I will,[pause=10] don't you worry![pause=0] I'll see you all again soon!

data.name: MNH5_043
data.value: O-oh![pause=0] {0},[pause=10] {1}![pause=0] H-how long have you been standing there?

data.name: MNH5_044
data.value: U-um, a little while, sorry.[pause=0] We didn't mean to intrude on you like this...

data.name: MNH5_045
data.value: No,[pause=10] it's okay.[pause=0] It IS a little embarrasing,[pause=10] but...

data.name: MNH5_046
data.value: I care about my family a lot,[pause=10] so it doesn't bother me if other people know that.

data.name: MNH5_047
data.value: Aww,[pause=10] that's sweet,[pause=10] {0}.[pause=0] I can see that your family cares deeply about you too!

data.name: MNH5_048
data.value: Eheheheh...

data.name: MNH5_049
data.value: Well,[pause=10] I'd better go prepare for the expedition.

data.name: MNH5_050
data.value: I know {0} probably hasn't gotten much done without me...

data.name: MNH5_051
data.value: {0} and I should go get ready too.[pause=0] Let's make this expedition a success,[pause=10] {1}!

data.name: MNH5_052
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] Let's all do our best!

data.name: MNH5_053
data.value: You're leaving today?

data.name: MNH5_054
data.value: Yup![pause=0] The Guildmaster announced we'd be departing later today.

data.name: MNH5_055
data.value: That's kinda sudden,[pause=10] don't you think?[pause=0] We knew your guild was planning some sort of expedition,[pause=10] but...

data.name: MNH5_056
data.value: We thought we'd have a little more warning!

data.name: MNH5_057
data.value: Yeah.[pause=0] The Guildmaster said we had to wait for {0} and {1} to return,[pause=10] but I didn't think we'd leave the minute they did!

data.name: MNH5_058
data.value: ...So we won't see you for quite a while.

data.name: MNH5_059
data.value: Yeah...[pause=0] With this being my first expedition and all,[pause=10] I don't know how long I'll be gone exactly.

data.name: MNH5_060
data.value: I came to say goodbye before I started preparing with {0} for the road ahead.

data.name: MNH5_061
data.value: Please keep an eye out for him.[pause=0] He's careful and very knowledgable on the mystery dungeons you're sure to encounter on this expedition,[pause=10] but...

data.name: MNH5_062
data.value: As his mother,[pause=10] I worry for his safety.[pause=0] Make sure he stays safe,[pause=10] would you please?

data.name: MNH6_001
data.value: Three famous rivals, and they turned down a child in trouble?[pause=0] My Almotz would never have hesitated.

data.name: MNH6_002
data.value: He came back from that mountain a little steadier.[pause=0] Fame doesn't seem to teach anyone that.

data.name: MNH6_003
data.value: Timmi keeps asking if the "famous ladies" are as good as his brother.[pause=0] I told him nobody's as good as his brother.

data.name: MNH6_004
data.value: I do wonder what {0} would say, seeing them turn away a lost little one.[pause=0] Probably something very blunt.

data.name: MNH6_005
data.value: Eight little ones under one roof, and the eldest still finds new ways to keep us on our toes.

data.name: MNH6_006
data.value: He's been home from the mountain a little while now.[pause=0] Still tells the story differently every time he's asked.

data.name: MNH6_007
data.value: A missing child, safe and found![pause=0] Almotz already told us the whole story before you'd even left the square.

data.name: MNH6_008
data.value: You've got good hearts, the lot of you.[pause=0] Almotz chose fine company to travel with, and he never stops saying so.

data.name: MNH6_009
data.value: The famous ladies wouldn't even TRY to save the little bug![pause=0] My brother would've gone in without a second thought!

data.name: MNH6_010
data.value: {0}'s gonna be SO mad he wasn't there for this one![pause=0] I can't wait to tell him tonight!

data.name: MNH6_011
data.value: Practicing my brave face, just like my brother taught me before HIS big expedition![pause=0] How's it look?

data.name: MNH6_012
data.value: You found the bug and everything, just like {0} would have![pause=0] He already came home and told us all about your rescue!
